class.name: NNBTCooldownTicks
class.brief_description: Prevents its child branch from running again for a fixed number of ticks after it finishes.
class.description: Use to rate-limit a branch by tick count (for example, in turn-based or fixed-step AI). Once the child returns a non-[constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] status, this decorator returns [member cooldown_return_value] without ticking the child for the next [member cooldown_ticks] ticks. For a time-based cooldown in seconds, use [NNBTCooldown].

members.member: Status returned while the cooldown is active. Defaults to [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
Number of ticks to wait after the child finishes before allowing it to run again. Set to [code]0[/code] or less to disable.
Ticks elapsed in the current cooldown. Equals [member cooldown_ticks] when ready.
